description: This Java source file defines the RootRoute class, which creates and manages the main HTTP routing setup for the '/'' context of an API gateway using the Akka HTTP framework. It includes route definitions for various subroutes such as /api, /ws, /health, /status, and custom routes, and handles cross-cutting concerns like exception handling, CORS, HTTPS enforcement, and authentication.

classes.name: RootRoute
classes.description: Main class to build HTTP routes for the gateway, includes subroutes, middleware, and configurations.

classes.name: RootRoute.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing RootRoute instances with custom configurations.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static method to obtain a builder for creating a RootRoute with specified HTTP configuration.

methods.name: buildRoute
methods.description: Constructs the main Akka HTTP route by combining all subroutes and directives.

methods.name: wrapWithRootDirectives
methods.description: Wraps the core route with exception handling, correlation ID, security, CORS, HTTPS enforcement, and logging.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Defines the '/api' route, including versioning and subroute dispatching.

methods.name: ensureSchemaVersion
methods.description: Validates and extracts the API schema version from the URL.

methods.name: apiAuthentication
methods.description: Applies authentication for the API route using provided directives.

methods.name: buildApiSubRoutes
methods.description: Builds subroutes within '/api', like policies, things, search, and whoami.

methods.name: buildSseThingsRoute
methods.description: Creates the server-sent events route for '/api/.../things'.

methods.name: ws
methods.description: Defines the WebSocket route under '/ws', including versioning and authentication.

methods.name: getUserAgentOrNull
methods.description: Extracts the 'User-Agent' header value from the request, or null if absent.

methods.name: withDittoHeaders
methods.description: Wraps a route with Ditto headers obtained asynchronously.

methods.name: javaFunctionToRoute
methods.description: Converts a Java route function to an Akka Route.

methods.name: routeToJavaFunction
methods.description: Converts an Akka Route to a Java route function.
